gloss: professional; a person with specialized expertise or someone who does something for a living

definitions.gloss: professional; a person with specialized expertise or someone who does something for a living
definitions.explanation: Can be used as a noun (a professional) or as a na-adjective (professional-quality).

examples.japanese: プロフェッショナルな{仕事|しごと}ぶりだ。
{彼女|かのじょ}は{料理|りょうり}のプロフェッショナルだ。
examples.english: She is a professional when it comes to cooking.

examples.japanese: プロフェッショナルとして{長年|ながねん}の{経験|けいけん}を{積|つ}んできた。
examples.english: I have built up many years of experience as a professional.

notes:
A loanword from English "professional." Used to describe someone with high-level expertise in their field, or the quality of being skilled and competent. Often implies dedication and pride in one's craft beyond mere employment.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- プロフェッショナルな{意識|いしき}: professional mindset
- プロフェッショナルな{対応|たいおう}: professional response/handling
- プロフェッショナルとしての{誇|ほこ}り: pride as a professional
- プロフェッショナルの{流儀|りゅうぎ}: the ways of a professional

SIMILAR WORDS:
- プロ: pro (common abbreviation, more casual)
- {専門家|せんもんか}: specialist, expert
- {職人|しょくにん}: craftsman, artisan
- アマチュア: amateur (antonym)

CULTURAL NOTE:
The NHK TV documentary series "プロフェッショナル {仕事|しごと}の{流儀|りゅうぎ}" (Professionals: The Ways of Work) has made this word widely familiar. The full form プロフェッショナル carries more weight and formality than the abbreviation プロ.
